caption.text: In trading in my 1987 mechanic shirt for a 100%  buffalo hide vest handmade by the indigenous tribes of Colombia, I feel my transformation from Joe to TicoJoe is complete 🇨🇴🦬🇨🇷 #joefelz #leathercraft #transformation #indigenous #tico

Guys we did it- we hiked 16 miles barefoot through the jungle to contact my first indigenous tribe. This was a mind blowing experience & I have so much to edit but can’t wait to get it all out for yall to see!!!

Also, your daily reminder to do epic shit 🇨🇴🛖💗 #joefelz #indigenous #hiking #jungle #experience

This has been one of the most saddest happiest yuckiest 7 days of my life- BUT…I can confidently give you guys a chicken update🐣

Out of 33 eggs, we have a so far mostly thriving 18 baby chicks with 6 eggs that were dropped later on that are still cooking🍳

We’ve had everything from suffocation, bloody belly buttons or butts, compacted poops, failure to thrive, eyes stuck shut, late bloomers etc. TOUGH MAN💔

Homesteading is not no hoe🐓🌾👩‍🌾 #homesteading #chickens #buildingreality #felzmedia #offgrid
Anyone got any idea what’s happening? 🇨🇷🚨🚓 #joefelz
I understand what they mean by “it’s lonely at the top” 🇨🇴⛰️💭 #joefelz #thoughts #mountaintop #earnit #outdoorlife

caption.text:
This is what I mean by there is high value in being low class.

I had never traditionally fished in my life, but that changed yesterday. @igniteselfmastery & I headed out with two local fisherman on a tiny boat with a motor that worked in fits and starts to catch our meal. Full video on YT @joefelz if you wanna see the whole thing.

We had no fishing poles, lures, or fishfinder, just waves vibes and a ton of fun. I have a newfound respect for these humble fisherman and the work ethic they embody to do this daily to feed themselves.

Although few people do it in 2026, I can confidently tell you that a meal tastes better when you catch it yourself. It was a great day for all, especially the street cat we blessed with our hard earned fish scraps. Viva Colombia 🇨🇴🎣😋 #joefelz #fishing #colombia #experiences #travel
Which hits harder: Taganga at day or Taganga at night? 🌄🤔🌃
